title: Direct proofs for spaces with cyclic parallel Ricci tensor
summary: We give direct proofs of rigidity results for gradient Ricci solitons, compact quasi-Einstein manifolds with boundary, and critical spaces with cyclic parallel Ricci tensor. For solitons and quasi-Einstein manifolds, successive traces of first-order pointwise identities yield quadratic equations for the Ricci tensor and its modification. These equations imply radial flatness and radial $Q$-flatness, respectively, and the corresponding global rigidity theorems apply.
